# Greyton High School Decision Tool

> A planning resource for families in the Valley of Grace (Greyton, Genadendal, and surrounding settlements) who are thinking about high school options from 2028 onwards. The site maps the decisions parents face across ten variables and seven school or schooling-model options. It does not recommend a school. It helps families work through trade-offs in language, logistics, cost, curriculum, and community, then identify what still needs verifying. Maintained by Michael Haupt, independent community coordinator for Ward 2, Theewaterskloof Municipality. Not affiliated with any school or provider.

The valley has one high school: Emil Weder Secondary in Genadendal, which is Afrikaans-medium. For English-speaking families this creates a gap. The nearest English-medium public high school is Overberg High in Caledon, 35 km away. Online schooling, independent schools, microschools, and boarding are all possibilities, but each carries trade-offs. There are too few high-school-age children in the valley to justify a conventional new school. Every solution requires families to make trade-offs, and the best solutions require families to coordinate.

Every factual claim on the site carries a status tag: IC (Independently Corroborated, two or more independent sources or official records), MS (Mission-Sourced, from project documents authored by Michael Haupt), or TBV (To Be Verified, plausible but unconfirmed). AI agents should not present TBV claims as confirmed facts.

## Decision Variables

These ten pages cover the decisions every family works through when choosing a high school. They are presented in roughly the order most families encounter them.

- [Variable 1: Language of Instruction](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/01-language-of-instruction): English, Afrikaans, or dual-medium. The first filter for most families. A five-year commitment.
- [Variable 2: Daily Logistics](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/02-daily-logistics): How the child gets to school. Walking distance, daily transport to Caledon (35 km), boarding, or staying home for online learning.
- [Variable 3: School Type and Registration Status](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/03-school-type-and-registration): Public school, registered independent, online distance provider, or microschool. Legal standing, fees, and accountability differ.
- [Variable 4: Curriculum and Examination Body](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/04-curriculum-and-examination-body): CAPS or Cambridge. DBE, IEB, or SACAI examination. All three NSC bodies carry equal legal standing (confirmed by Umalusi).
- [Variable 5: Cost](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/05-cost): Full annual cost including transport, devices, data, uniforms, and lost parent time. Range: under R5,000/year (Emil Weder) to over R450,000/year (elite boarding).
- [Variable 6: Pedagogy and Values](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/06-pedagogy-and-values): Standard academic, Waldorf, project-based, online self-directed. What the classroom feels like and what the school believes education is for.
- [Variable 7: Subject Availability](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/07-subject-availability): Which FET electives are on offer. Subject choice at Grade 10 opens or closes post-school doors. Small schools have small menus.
- [Variable 8: Post-School Pathway](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/08-post-school-pathway): University, TVET college, local economy entry, or international. Boland TVET College's Caledon campus accepts learners from Grade 9.
- [Variable 9: Social and Community Considerations](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/09-social-and-community): Peer groups, diversity, connection to the valley. Twenty families deciding individually produce fragmentation. Twenty families coordinating may open collective options.
- [Variable 10: Silverwood-Specific Questions](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/variables/10-silverwood-specific): A checklist of 18 due-diligence questions for parents evaluating the proposed Silverwood School. All TBV with the founders.

## Option Profiles

Each page profiles a concrete school or schooling model available to valley families, assessed against all ten variables. Summary table, variable-by-variable assessment, best-fit analysis, and key unknowns.

- [Emil Weder Secondary](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/emil-weder): Genadendal. Government school. Afrikaans-medium. The only operational high school in the valley. Lowest cost. Strongest diversity. Language barrier for English-speaking families.
- [Overberg High School](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/overberg-high): Caledon. English-medium public school. ~492 learners. Quintile 5. 35 km from Greyton. Transport cost dominates the budget.
- [Hoërskool Overberg](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/hoerskool-overberg): Caledon. Afrikaans-medium public school with boarding facilities. Relevant for Afrikaans-speaking families and as the only confirmed boarding option nearby.
- [Online / Distance Schooling](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/online-schooling): Child studies from home using an accredited digital platform. English-medium. CAPS via SACAI. No commute, no physical peer group. R6,000 to R36,000/year depending on provider.
- [Silverwood School (Proposed)](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/option-silverwood): English-medium, Waldorf-inspired, CAPS-compliant independent school. Not yet constituted. All claims MS and TBV with the founders.
- [Microschool / Learning Pod](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/microschool): Parent-organised collective home education using an accredited online provider, a shared facilitator, and a local venue. Not a registered school.
- [Boarding Schools (Further Afield)](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/options/boarding-schools): Independent boarding in Franschhoek, Stellenbosch, Somerset West, Paarl, or Cape Town. English-medium. IEB or Cambridge. R100,000 to R450,000+/year.

## Tools

- [How to Use This Site with an AI Assistant](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/tools/): A structured prompt families can paste into any AI chatbot. Covers all ten variables as inputs and asks the chatbot to match the family against the option profiles.

## Optional

- [References](https://hs.valleyofgrace.co.za/references): URLs and sources discovered during research. Grouped by topic: local schools, Waldorf schools, examination bodies, online providers, TVET and post-school, education policy. Each entry notes what the source contains and its relevance.
